Team — forwarding ClarityRx question. Summary of ask: they need recommended envelope sequencing and contingency plan if their primary signer (CEO) is unavailable. They also asked about witness/notary and how we deliver final clean copies.

What I propose (subject to legal sign-off):
- Primary signer: ClarityRx CEO (recommended) -> Secondary: CFO -> Tertiary: VP Legal (explicit alternate signer list in envelope).
- If primary not available, we should permit the CFO to sign provided their name/email is pre-populated and ClarityRx confirms authority via a short delegation email (we can accept a scanned POA).
- For cross-state notarization: we generally do not require notarization for SaaS MSAs; if customer requests notarization we can accommodate but will need a follow-up SOW and timing note.
- Final clean copies: we send final signed PDFs to both parties and publish a timestamped S3 archive link; include a single-page execution certificate as part of the envelope.

Laura / Priyom — can you confirm acceptance of the above and flag any DocuSign sequencing constraints (embedded signer, ID verification options, conditional routing)? Ben — can you stage the two final artifacts (MSA_clean_redline + OrderForm_FINAL) for envelope upload?

Thanks,

Diego —

Agree with the proposed approach with a few operational constraints and one recommended edit:

1) Signer rotation: list primary (CEO) -> secondary (CFO) -> tertiary (VP Legal). Please have ClarityRx include an explicit alternate-signer authorization email (short: name, title, email, and statement of authority) that we can attach to the envelope metadata. This removes ambiguity when CFO signs in lieu of CEO.

2) ID verification: for CFO signing in lieu we recommend enabling DocuSign ID verification (phone/email + access code). If ClarityRx can't support ID verification we will require the delegation email + a scan of internal authorization (they already attached a PO; PO alone is insufficient).

3) Witness/notary: Not needed for execution of our standard MSA. If ClarityRx insists on notarization, routing will be manual (we'll need to pull the PDF, arrange for notary, then re-upload a notarized PDF) — this extends close by ~5 business days. Advise ClarityRx accordingly.

4) Envelope sequencing & fallback: we will create a sequential envelope with conditional routing: if primary signer rejects or does not act within 72 hours, the envelope auto-routes to the secondary. If both primary and secondary fail, tertiary receives a notification and can sign as last resort. Ensure alternate emails are pre-populated.

5) Clean copies: Redwood will publish a signed PDF to our secure S3 path and email copies to both signing parties. We will append an execution certificate page (signer names, timestamps, envelope ID). If ClarityRx requires a separate archival package (zip + audit log), we can include that as an optional attachment in DocuSign.

Ben/Priyom — please prepare the envelope assets and set DocuSign ID verification on the CFO role. Also attach the final redline (MSA_ClarityRx_clean_redline.pdf) and OrderForm_ClarityRx_FINAL.pdf.

Laura Bennett
